title: QuickBooks bill payments disappeared without an accounts-payable match
evidence: The v0.12.1 changelog and merged diff document an inner-to-left join change because the account lookup could be empty and remove transactions. This case uses the bill payment model among the five changed models.
source_sql:
inner join ap_accounts
    on ap_accounts.source_relation = bill_payments.source_relation
adaptation: Supplies synthetic inputs to bill_payment_join and selects only its transaction ID and account ID. The dbt staging and double-entry output steps are omitted.
before_sql:
SELECT p.bill_payment_id AS id, a.account_id
FROM bill_payments AS p INNER JOIN ap_accounts AS a ON a.source_relation = p.source_relation
after_sql:
SELECT p.bill_payment_id AS id, a.account_id
FROM bill_payments AS p LEFT JOIN ap_accounts AS a ON a.source_relation = p.source_relation
